What the comparison means

Fastest recorded race lap by either driver of the selected constructor at this circuit in that car’s season. Average speed is the source’s lap-average speed, not maximum or instantaneous speed. Different seasons, drivers, tyres, fuel, weather and traffic prevent a controlled car-only comparison.

Open this event’s API data ↗

Race data: Jolpica-F1 · CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 · Data provenance & changes

What the animation means

Cars move at uniform distance per second around a community reference layout, using the recorded lap duration when available. No corner-speed, braking, throttle or tyre telemetry is inferred. Car markers reuse the Qvist concept geometry, not exact team chassis. Cars and road width are enlarged for visibility; elevation, buildings and exact historical layout variants are not reproduced.

Layout source / Tomislav Bacinger ↗ · MIT licence
RESEARCH / DATA COLLECTION

Teach the next interaction.

In trained-model mode, record labelled 32-frame sequences of normalized hand landmarks. Enable the camera in Explore first. Record idle movement as well as intentional gestures.

0 sequences recorded. No synthetic training data.

Recordings remain in this tab until exported. Landmark coordinates can be identifying; export only with participant consent.

EXPERIMENT / PIPELINE

From movement to meaning.

  1. Collect real gesturesMultiple people, sessions, backgrounds. Idle is a required class.
  2. Split by participantSeparate train, validation and test people before tuning.
  3. Compare architecturesMean-pooling MLP → LSTM → temporal Transformer.
  4. Tune on validation onlyOptuna search with pruning and early stopping.
  5. Evaluate & deployMacro-F1, confusion matrix, CPU latency and checkpoint size.
Open project source ↗

Includes PyTorch training, Optuna tuning, a FastAPI inference service, Docker, tests and a step-by-step guide.

CUSTOM MODEL / CONNECTION

Bring your trained model online.

The current viewer uses transparent rule-based controls. After training, connect the local FastAPI service: its temporal model gates rotation and zoom. Selection uses the index fingertip as a cursor.
